title: hyrox acquisition looks injury prone 2026 09 10
author: Katrina Hamlin
text:
HONG KONG, Sept 10 (Reuters Breakingviews) - As an investment, Hyrox looks injury prone. The novel fitness racing series has a cult-like following, and a consortium led by LVMH-backed ​L Catterton is betting the franchise is more than a fad. But competitors are already muscling in. That ‌will make it harder for the brand that attracts both gym bunnies and runners to bulk up.
Its competitions have leapt from roughly 700 participants in 2017 to around 1.4 million in the latest season and have won sponsors including Puma (PUMG.DE)
, opens new tab
, Red Bull, BYD (002594.SZ)
, opens new tab
 and insurer AIA (1299.HK)
, opens new tab
. Creators Christian ​Toetzke, former CEO of Ironman, and Moritz Fürste, an Olympian, devised a format where individuals or teams alternate between ​1km intervals and functional exercises, such as burpees and lunges. A standardised course, typically held in ⁠large venues that can accommodate thousands of people, allows athletes to compare times as well as abs across about 100 global ​events each year.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed but the sale
, opens new tab
 of a controlling stake, announced on Tuesday by Infront ​Sports and Media, whose parent is Chinese conglomerate Wanda, may value
, opens new tab
 Hyrox at around €600 million ($697 million), according to Bloomberg. The company’s founders are investing alongside L Catterton.
Debt-laden Wanda, which first invested in Hyrox via Infront in 2019, may have picked a good moment to bow out. For now, demand is ​higher than supply: its New York event in May welcomed 50,000 athletes and had a waiting list of more than ​21,000, Fürste said in a recent interview
, opens new tab
. The group is also looking to build revenue from spectator tickets and merchandise.
Yet fitness crazes can be short-lived: ‌Peloton (PTON.O)
, opens new tab
, ⁠another company L Catterton previously backed, saw paid subscriptions for its online exercise classes slump 8.8% last year. Hyrox athletes will be tempted by new challenges. Even if fitness racing continues to gain credibility as a sport, rivals are stepping up. Race organiser Spartan has a similar competition. In China, a former Hyrox coach held
, opens new tab
 the inaugural event for his new brand BTWE in June.
The ​group expects sales to reach
, opens new tab
 $270 million this ​year, per CNBC. That ⁠implies a forward price-to-sales multiple above 2.5 – below other listed sports groups like Ultimate Fighting Championship owner TKO (TKO.N)
, opens new tab
 or Manchester United (MANU.N)
, opens new tab
, but still much higher than 1.4 times for event organiser Live ​Nation (LYV.N)
, opens new tab
, and 1 times at Peloton, per Visible Alpha and LSEG data. Problem is, fitness ​fads can easily ⁠trip up.
